name: Umiko
source: “The oldest of the three ninjas, Umiko is sadistic, possessive, and feared by her peers. She’s generally uninterested in the goals of her clan and instead enjoys hunting and capturing her prey. While she originally sees you as just another mark, the closer she gets to you, the more she realizes she wants you for herself.”
